target.metric: orientation-averaged initial leakage divided by uncontrolled initial leakage

contract.governing_equations: Gamma=2J^2 sum_n |c_n(u)|^2 kappa/(kappa^2+n^2 Omega^2); Gamma0=2J^2/kappa. Uniform filtered bound Gamma/Gamma0<=(2*pi^(t+1)/(t+1)!+A/B)^2+(kappa/Omega)^2.
assumptions: One weak resonant transfer channel with exponential amplitude memory; common supplied d0>0.
Fixed orientation over cycles, prepared donor population, linear differential Stark response over all peak and frequency support.
Positive cubature and traversal occupy real time; filtering adds carrier defect. No arbitrary instantaneous control or multi-channel norm coverage.
contract.conservation_and_thermodynamics: Parseval normalizes Fourier weights; waveform RMS and peak are accounted separately. Rate suppression is not free energy, population preparation, longer lifetime or chemical yield.
contract.materials: Actual molecular species/channel, differential Stark vector, environment and orientation stabilization unacquired. Do not combine Stark slopes and IVR rates from different systems.
contract.units_and_tolerances: Angular frequencies for kappa/Omega/B; source wavenumber conversion must distinguish amplitude and population decay. Numerical quadrature/alias estimates exclude roundoff certification.
contract.input_acquisition: Obtain a same-species d0/kappa/J calibration satisfying the exact weak-transfer model plus actual three-axis amplitude/phase transfer function and frozen-orientation interval.
contract.error_budget: Charge field and timing errors, finite-bandwidth carrier residual, orientation drift, norm distribution, additional channels, resonance shifts, bath mismatch and readout/model uncertainty.
contract.energy_balance: UNKNOWN actual energy. RMS field is not delivered power; charge field generation, geometry/losses, preparation/readout, heating, ionization and damage. Higher peak/bandwidth may erase any practical benefit.
contract.reliability: Control every admitted frozen orientation only under the theorem premises. Numerical average over 200 orientations is not that uniform guarantee or a molecular population lifetime.
contract.resources: Calibrated preparation, suitable same-species channel, vector field bandwidth/peak and time-resolved leakage metrology are unacquired; estimated apparatus cost UNKNOWN.
